Asm/ClobberAbiCall: Its assembly calls a function by the Windows x64 convention (arguments in rcx and rdx).
Asm/FileScope: Its assembly defines functions that take their arguments by the Windows x64 convention.
Lifecycle/ThreadLocalForeignThread: Starts its foreign thread with the Windows API (CreateThread).
MemoryGC/CollectionPauses: Needs concurrent marking, which Linux does not do: it keeps no record of written pages (D-79, D-86).
Scripting/EmulatedThreadStorage: Uses the script runtime, which comes to Linux with the compiler and its JIT (D-86).
Scripting/ScriptExits: Uses the script runtime, which comes to Linux with the compiler and its JIT (D-86).
Types/ThreadLocalCounter: Starts its threads with the Windows API (CreateThread).
Bedrock/Bug276ReparsePointNotLink: Its C source makes an NTFS reparse point with the Windows API.
Interop/CppExceptionsAndInterfaces: C++ and C4 exceptions cross each other's frames only on Windows, where both are MSVC's; on Linux C4's personality catches a C++ exception only with catch (...) (D-86).
Interop/ExportedData: Exports data from the executable with __declspec(dllexport), as a D3D12 program does for the Agility SDK.
Interop/ExportedDataIncremental: Exports data from the executable with __declspec(dllexport), as a D3D12 program does for the Agility SDK.
Interop/InitListInterop: Passes std::initializer_list by the MSVC ABI (CallEmitter::LinkedInitializerList).
Platform/ProtectionFaults: Uses the script host (--script-host), which is Windows' until the compiler runs on Linux.
Platform/ResourceFile: Links a compiled Windows resource file (.res).
